headline: 288 photos uploaded in 10 minutes by Collector & District Magistrate
reasons: 288 different photos for 180 different works were uploaded by Collector & District Magistrate within 10 minutes, from 2026-05-24 12:48:37 to 2026-05-24 12:58:34.
That is about one work every 3 seconds on average.
The works are in 11 villages: Amabahara, Awari, Bhengri, Chikhali, Dhobani, Pakur Bhat, Parekibhat, Parreguda, Rani Tarai, Sankara (J), Sankara K.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
